notes.title: Modus Sonum will be available soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends, we have good news! Our new app Modus Sonum will be available soon!
The application is a powerful sequencer for creating electronic music. Connect different sound sources, add sound effects and get an accomplished song! This musical constructor will not leave indifferent fans of electro and hardcore styles, as well as fans of collecting schemes.
We hope you enjoy our idea. We will wait for your feedback!

Music Breath Team
